items.name: Kubkvarna 2022
items.information: Välkomna till Kubkvarna 2022, en tävling som ännu en gång välkomnar er alla till härliga Folkets Park i Huskvarna. Alla är välkomna att delta, vare sig du löser kuben på 10 minuter eller 6 sekunder. Läs igenom alla flikar på denna sida noga, då de innehåller mycket värdefull information om tävlingen. Notera även att medlemmar i SveKub har 25% rabatt på anmälningsavgiften. Att bli medlem är **gratis**, mer information finns under fliken SveKub, och på [SveKubs hemsida](https://svekub.se/bli-medlem/). ------ Welcome to Kubkvarna 2022, a competition that once again welcomes you all to the lovely Folket Park in Huskvarna. Everyone is welcome to compete, whether you solve the cube in 10 minutes or 6 seconds. Please read through all the tabs on this site carefully, as they contain very useful about the competition. Note that members of SveKub have a 25% discount on the registration fee. Membership is available for everyone with a Swedish personal number, and it is **free**. Read more on the SveKub tab, or on [SveKub's website](https://svekub.se/en/bli-medlem/).

items.information: **Español** Esta es la primera competencia organizada en esta sede y también será la primera competencia oficial del año en Quetzaltenango. Kukulcán Open 2026 será una competencia oficial de la World Cube Association (WCA), inspirada en la cultura maya y en la figura de Kukulcán, uno de los símbolos más representativos de Mesoamérica. Nuestro objetivo es ofrecer una experiencia competitiva de alta calidad, promoviendo la comunidad del speedcubing en el occidente de Guatemala y mostrando parte de nuestra identidad y cultura a todos los participantes. Esta competencia se llevará a cabo en dos locaciones diferentes. Para consultar la ubicación correspondiente a cada día, revisa la pestaña “Distribución de áreas / Venue Layout”, donde se indica la ubicación de la competencia para el viernes 11, así como para los días sábado 12 y domingo 13. ¡Sean todos bienvenidos a Quetzaltenango y esperamos que disfruten de Kukulcán Open 2026! **English** This is the first competition organized at this venue and also the first official WCA competition of the year in Quetzaltenango. Kukulcán Open 2026 is an official World Cube Association (WCA) competition inspired by the Mayan culture and Kukulcán, one of the most iconic symbols of Mesoamerica. Our goal is to provide a high-quality competition while helping grow the speedcubing community in western Guatemala and sharing part of our culture and identity with every participant. This competition will take place at two different venues. Please refer to the “Distribución de áreas / Venue Layout” tab to find the competition location for Friday the 11th, as well as for Saturday the 12th and Sunday the 13th. Welcome to Quetzaltenango—we hope you enjoy Kukulcán Open 2026! ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MjA2Njg3LCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--be50ae158823f554eaf24566a8f1a7aa4c6d9eb2/IMG_4169.png)

items.information: Kilpailupaikalla saa olla yhtä aikaa maksimissaan 150 ihmistä. Jokainen kilpailija saa tuoda mukanaan yhden vieraan. Kilpailijoille ja heidän mukana tuleville vieraille jaetaan kaulanauhat. Paikalle saa tulla muita katsojia kunhan tilassa ei ole enempää kuin 150 ihmistä kerrallaan. Mikäli järjestyksenvalvoja huomauttaa väkimäärästä, paikalta voidaan poistaa niitä joilla ei ole kaulanauhaa. At the venue there can be simultaneously 150 people at most. Every competitor may bring one guest with them. Competitors and their guests are given badges. Everyone else is welcome to the venue at all times as long as no more than 150 people is present at once. In case security officer notifys that there could be too many people those without badges could be denied entry to the venue.

items.name: Kyub sa Aga Masskara 2024
items.information: **US (English)** The Negros Speedcubers Organizing Committee is thrilled to present the **Kyub sa Masskara 2024** competition series, two competitions held in one day—morning and afternoon, in celebration of the Masskara Festival in Bacolod City! This competition will be held in the morning, the afternoon competition can be found [here](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/KyubsaHaponMasskara2024/register). Competitors **shall only compete in one of the two competitions**, either [Kyub sa Aga](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/KyubsaAgaMasskara2024) or [Kyub sa Hapon](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/KyubsaHaponMasskara2024). This is strictly implemented. We strongly encourage you to stay 'til the end of both competitions as there will be awards. All events in both competitions are the same and will consist of a single round. For more details about the competition, please refer to the tabs above. By registering, competitors and their guests—including but not limited to family members, friends, and guardians—acknowledge and agree that the organizing bodies, their personnel, and any associated individuals shall not be held liable for any harm or injury, loss of personal belongings or property, or emotional distress resulting from participation in this competition. Please be familiar with the [WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/full/) before participating in this event. *** **PH (Tagalog)** Ikinagagalag na hinahandog ng Negros Speedcubers Organizing Committee ang **Kyub sa Masskara 2024** kompetisyong serye, dalawang kompetisyon na gaganapin sa isang araw—umaga at hapon, bilang pagdiriwang ng Masskara Festival sa Lungsod ng Bacolod! Ang kompetisyong ito ay magaganap sa umaga. Ang hapong edisyon ay makikita [dito](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/KyubsaHaponMasskara2024). Ang mga kalahok ay **dapat na makilahok sa isang kompetisyon lamang**, maaring [Kyub sa Aga](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/KyubsaAgaMasskara2024) o [Kyub sa Hapon](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/KyubsaHaponMasskara2024). Ito ay mahigpitang ipinapatupad. Ang lahat ng kategorya sa dalawang kompetisyon ay magkapareho at binubuo ng isang round lamang. Para sa karagdagang impormasyon sa kompetisyon, maaring i-klik ang mga tabs sa itaas. Sa pamamagitan ng pagrerehistro, ang mga kalahok at kanilang mga bisita—kabilang ngunit hindi limitado sa mga miyembro ng pamilya, kaibigan, at mga tagapag-alaga—ay kinikilala at sumasang-ayon na ang mga namamahalang katawan, kanilang mga tauhan, at anumang kaugnay na indibidwal ay hindi mananagot para sa anumang pinsala o sakuna, pagkawala ng personal na pag-aari o kagamitan, o emosyonal na pagkabalisa na resulta ng paglahok sa kompetisyon na ito. Maging pamilyar sa [WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/full/) bago makilahok sa kompetisyong ito. *** **PH (Hiligaynon)** Bugal nga gina-anunsyo Negros Speedcubers Organizing Committee ang **Kyub sa Masskara 2024**, duha ka kompetisyon nga gina hiwat sa isa ka adlaw—aga kag hapon, para i-selebrar ang maabot nga Masskara Festival sa syudad sang Bacolod. Hiliwaton ang kompetisyon nga ini sa aga. Ang hapon nga edisyon, makita [diri](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/KyubsaHaponMasskara2024). Sa mga maintra, **isa lang dapat ka kompetisyon ang intrahan**, pwede nga [Kyub sa Aga](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/KyubsaAgaMasskara2024) ukon [Kyub sa Hapon](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/KyubsaHaponMasskara2024). Ini ang strikto nga gina sunod. Ang tanan nga kategorya sa duha nga kompetisyon parehas lang kag ginalakipan sang isa ka round. Para sa mas madamo pa gid nga impormasyon, palihog i-klik ang mga tabs sa babaw. Paagi sa pagrehistro, ang mga maintra kag ang ila mga kaupod—lakip na apang indi limitado sa mga miyembro sang pamilya, abyan, kag mga tagabantay—nagasugot kag nagakilala nga ang mga nagadumala, ila mga personnel, kag bisan ano nga may kaangtanan nga mga indibidwal indi manabat para sa bisan ano nga samad o aksidente, pagkadula sang personal nga gamit, ukon emosyonal nga kasakit nga resulta sang pag-apil sa sini nga kompetisyon. Maging pamilyar sa [WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/full/) antis mag-intra sa kompetisyon nga ini. ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MzU0ODMsInB1ciI6ImJsb2JfaWQifX0=--c50c26c64cb1b9f822467f54be10667c701e1a75/Untitled%20design%20(14).png)

items.information: Velkommen til hverdagskubing på LSP i Oslo. Dette er et nytt arrangement i Oslo der ideen er å arrangere mindre konkurranser på hverdagskvelder gjennom hele året. Vi holder til i et lite lokale sentralt i Oslo der LSPkuberne pleier å ha kubetreff. Vi håper å nå både erfarne og nye speedcubere i Oslo som har lyst til å prøve seg på konkurranser lokalt. Vi vil lage månedlige konkurranser fram til sommeren og se hvilket format som funker. Målet er å starte Osloligaen til høsten, der vi kårer en vinner etter resultatene fra flere små konkurranser gjennom høsten og vinteren. Konkurransen er sponset av Nordicube.

items.name: LSP Hverdagskubing Mai 2023

venue.name: LSP
venue.details: Stort rosa bygg. Inngang fra Østerdalsgata. 1. etg med LSP Beachflagg utenfor.

items.information: Hjertelig velkommen til vår andre hverdagskubing på LSP i Oslo. Kveldens konkurranse har et veldig spesielt opplegg, der hver deltaker har 18 minutter i total løsningstid til å gjennomføre alle sine løsninger. Det er deltageren selv som på forhånd velger hvilke grener man vil delta i og bruke sine 18 minutter på. Konkurransen foregår mandag kveld og varer i tilsammen ca 4 timer og du kan delta i maks 5 grener. Vi holder til i et lite lokale sentralt i Oslo der LSPkuberne pleier å ha kubetreff. Vi håper at både erfarne og nye speedcubere i Oslo har lyst til å prøve seg på konkurranser lokalt. Vi vil lage månedlige konkurranser framover og se hvilket format som funker. Målet er å starte Osloligaen til høsten, der vi kårer en vinner etter resultatene fra flere små konkurranser gjennom høsten og vinteren. Lokalet er har minimalt med tilskuerplass, så det er fint hvis antall gjester er så lavt som mulig. Konkurransen er sponset av NORDICUBE og SLOAP. -------------------- Welcome to the second edition of LSP Hverdagskubing in Oslo. This competitions has a very special format, where each competitor has a total of 18 minutes of solving time to complete all their solves. The competitor gets to choose which events to spend their time on. Note, that each competitor can choose a maximum of five (5) events to compete in. The competition, which this time takes place on a Monday, lasts only approx. 4 hours. Please read through all the tabs on this page (especially "Hverdagskubing") so you don't miss any important information. We are based in a small venue in the center of Oslo where the LSPcubers tend to have cube meetings. We hope that both experienced and new speedcubers in Oslo want to join these local competitions. We will create monthly competitions in the future and see which format works. The aim is to start the Oslo League in the autumn, where we will choose a winner based on the results of several small competitions throughout the autumn and winter. The venue has limited space for guests. Please bring as few guests as possible. The competition is sponsored by NORDICUBE and SLOAP.

venue.name: [COPARMEX](https://maps.app.goo.gl/qSqUKBfg8qAVmz7i9)
venue.address: Av. Cuauhtémoc 757, Barrio Antiguo, Centro, 64000 Monterrey, N.L.

items.information: # **Español** Les presentamos el gemelo opuesto de la famosa competencia de speedcubing de Monterrey: La Silla. La Sillan't es para aquellos que buscan algo diferente. Esta competencia tiene todas las categoriás que no son NxN, One-Handed y Blind, para que todos, con gustos distintos, también puedan disfrutar. Esta competencia es reconocida como una competencia de la Asociación Mundial del Cubo. Por lo tanto, todos los competidores deben estar familiarizados y entender el[ Reglamento de la WCA](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/spanish-american/) # **English** We present to you the opposite twin of the famous Monterrey speedcubing competition: La Silla. La Sillan't is for those looking for something different. This competition features all categories that are not NxN, One-Handed, and Blind, so that everyone with different tastes can also enjoy. This competition is recognized as an official World Cube Association event. Therefore, all competitors must be familiar with and understand the [WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/)

venue.name: Langenstein Stockhalle
venue.details: Follow the signs to the venue

items.information: English version is below Deutsch: Wir freuen uns sehr euch Langenstein City Blind Open 2026 als ein offizielles WCA Turnier ankündigen zu können. Die Speedcubing Competition wird organisiert von Simon Praschl, Martin Fröhlich, Philipp Leimer und Thomas Strasser und delegiert von Pranjal Khan, Fabian Staber und Jan Křížka. Diesmal findet die Competition in der Eisstockhalle in Langenstein statt. Die Resultate dieser Competition werden zu den offiziellen WCA World Rankings hinzugefügt. Jeder ist bei diesem Turnier gerne willkommen, unabhängig von der Erfahrung, Alter oder sonstigen Fähigkeiten. Manche Events haben ein spezifisches Zeitlimit, damit wir sicherstellen können den ganzen Tag über im Zeitplan zu bleiben. Es dürfen Puzzles jeder Marke verwendet werden solange sie den WCA Richtlinien entsprechen. Es sind alle Herzlich willkommen! Jeder Teilnehmer darf einen Gast mitbringen. Wir freuen uns besonders auf neue Speedcuber aus Österreich! English: We are happy to announce the Langenstein City Blind Open 2026 as an official WCA Competition. The speedcubing competition is organised by Simon Praschl, Martin Fröhlich, Philipp Leimer and Thomas Strasser and delegated by Pranjal Khan, Fabian Staber and Jan Křížka. Results of the competition will be added to the official WCA World Rankings. The competition is open to all competitors regardless of experience and skill, but certain event-based time limits will be in place to make sure we can stay on schedule and get through the day on time. No prior experience in WCA competitions is necessary, but competitors must be familiar with the WCA Regulations. Any puzzle brand may be used during the competition, as long as it complies with the WCA regulations. Every Competitor can bring one guest.

items.name: Larissa Spring Open 2023
items.information: ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBdm8xIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--dd65eb480c4a2f6ae601106b518d7da158eeb179/336963227_762958098547893_38350618552278990_n.jpg) Larissa Spring Open 2023 είναι ο δεύτερος διαγωνισμός για φέτος στην Ελλάδα. Στη σειρά διαγωνισμών Road to Greek Nationals, θα εστιάζουμε πάντα σε 2 events που δεν είναι ακόμα πολύ γνωστά στην Ελλάδα. Σε αυτό το διαγωνισμό θέλουμε να φέρουμε τα αγωνίσματα του 3x3x3 blindfolded και του Skewb πιο κοντά στους συμμετέχοντες. Ο στόχος είναι να διεξαχθεί το πρώτο ελληνικό εθνικό πρωτάθλημα προς το τέλος του τρέχοντος έτους. Μέχρι τότε, όλα τα events θα είναι οικεία στους συμμετέχοντες. Πάρτε τους κύβους σας, ετοιμαστείτε, διαβάστε τους κανόνες και ελάτε σε μία ακόμα γιορτή του cubing! Παρακαλώ διαβάστε αναλυτικά τις επόμενες σελίδες για να βρείτε όλες τις απαραίτητες πληροφορίες. Σημείωση: Για να θεωρείται ολοκληρωμένη μία εγγραφή πρέπει να ολοκληρωθεί το registrations στο site της wca ΚΑΙ να γίνει η πληρωμή της εισόδου με την κάρτα σας μέσω της πλατφόρμας πληρωμών stripe που χρησιμοποιεί η WCA, όπως περιγράφεται στις καρτέλες δίπλα. [Εγγραφή στη WCA, σε επίσημο διαγωνισμό και πολλά ακόμα. Οδηγός για πρωτάρηδες.](https://youtu.be/RS768gK0Vrg) Larissa Spring Open 2023 is the second competition this year in Greece. In the next "Road to Greek finals" competitions, we will always focus on 2 events that are not yet very well known in Greece. In this competition we want to bring the events 3x3x3 blindfolded and Skewb closer to the competitors. The goal is to make the first Greek National Championship towards the end of this year. By then, all events will be familiar to the competitors. Grab your cubes, study the regulations and attend the greek feast of cubing! Please read the following tabs very carefully! Note: For a registration to be considered valid, the competitor should both register though the WCA site and pay the fee as described in the nexts tabs.

I partecipanti dovranno essere seduti e pronti a cominciare i tentativi agli orari prestabiliti. **Il costo di registrazione per questa competizione è:** * €10 (Euro) per i soci di Cubing Italy (nota: associarsi è gratutito, maggiori informazioni sotto). * €20 (Euro) per i non soci di Cubing Italy (nota: i non soci dovranno pagare, oltre ai €10 online, €10 in loco nel caso decidessero di non associarsi). ___ ![Image description](https://i.imgur.com/YSp2SyW.png) This competition will take place in Monterotondo (RM) and San Gregorio di Catania (CT) simultaneously. ​ Competitors *MUST* specify in the comments of the registration the city they wish to compete in. ​ Please note that the **ONLY** event at this competitions is **3x3x3 Fewest Moves**. Competitors should be seated and ready to start the attempts at the scheduled start times. **The registration fee for this competition is:** * €10 (Euro) for Cubing Italy Cubing Italy Members (note: this membership is free, see more below). * €20 (Euro) for Cubing Italy non-members (note: non-members will have to pay €10 online plus €10 on site if they decide not to become Member).

items.information: Pēc trīs gadu pārtraukuma Latvijā atgriežas lielākās sacensības – **Latvijas čempionāts** – atdzimis un uzlabots! Sacensībās būs pārstāvētas gandrīz visas oficiālās WCA disciplīnas, kā arī notiks Iesācēju kauss un 3x3x3 kubs ar aizvērtām acīm pāros, lai piešķirtu pasākumam nelielu odziņu. Balvas varēs saņemt tikai Latvijas pilsoņi, taču sacensībās piedalīties aicināti dalībnieki no jebkuras valsts. FMC disciplīnas čempionāts notiks citā datumā. Šīs būs jau piektās sacensības, kas norisināsies Siguldā. ----------------------------------------------------- After a three-year break, the biggest competition in Latvia is back – **Latvian Championship** – reborn and improved! Amost all official WCA events will be featured, along with a Beginners’ Cup and 3x3x3 team-blindfolded to add a little twist to the competition. Only Latvian citizens are eligible for prizes, but participants from any country are welcome to compete. The FMC championship will be held on a different date. venue.address: Av. Santos Dumont, 4360 - Centro, Lauro de Freitas - BA, 42702-400

items.information: A inscrição é aberta a qualquer pessoa, de qualquer nacionalidade. Visando ao bom andamento da competição, ao se inscrever em uma categoria, você se compromete também a ajudar como juiz ou embaralhador nessa categoria (conforme previsto nas regras da WCA). Dessa forma, a competição se torna autossustentável, e as atividades são divididas entre todos os participantes, não ficando pesado para apenas alguns. Foram feitos pelo menos dois grupos em cada modalidade. Em um dos grupos você compete e no outro ajuda a embaralhar ou sendo juiz. **ATENÇÃO:** Competidores menores de 16 anos devem estar acompanhadas por um responsável. Ressaltamos que a competição ocorrerá em um espaço público, e a organização não se responsabiliza pela supervisão das crianças. --- Registration is open to any person, from any country. With a view to the smooth running of the competition, by registering for a category, you also undertake to help as a judge or scrambler in that category (as provided for in the WCA rules). In this way, the competition becomes self-sustaining, and the activities are divided among all participants, not becoming heavy for just a few. At least two groups were made in each modality. In one of the groups you compete and in the other you help to scramble or judge. **ATTENTION:** Competitors under 16 must be accompanied by a guardian. Please note that the competition will take place in a public space, and the organization is not responsible for supervising children.

items.name: Leersum Algs 24 Hours in 2024
items.information: Deze wedstrijd gaat over 24u. Graag alleen aanmelden als je het grootste deel van die 24u aanwezig zult zijn. Het komen voor een paar uur wordt niet gewaardeerd. Let op het [tijdschema](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/LeersumAlgs24Hoursin2024#competition-schedule)! De populaire onderdelen zijn gepland voor de avond. Het onderdeel 3x3x3 Cube is bijvoorbeeld pas gepland om 21:10u in de avond. This competition will be running for 24 hours. Please only register if you will be present for most of those 24 hours. Coming for a few hours only is not appreciated. Pay attention to the[ time schedule](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/LeersumAlgs24Hoursin2024#competition-schedule)! The popular events are planned in the evening. E.g. the event 3x3x3 Cube is planned until 9:10pm in the evening.

items.name: Let's Solve Liberec 2025
items.information: ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6NTYzNTAsInB1ciI6ImJsb2JfaWQifX0=--3108208eb7baaec4005983963bd4455293cbb240/1000049076.png) ### ČEŠTINA Tato soutěž se účastní oficiálního Měsíce nováčků WCA 2025. Při registraci bude 50 % míst vyhrazeno pro nováčky. Za nováčky se považují ti, kteří ještě na své první WCA soutěži nebyli, nebo na ní byli v roce 2025 (nemají WCA ID, nebo mají WCA ID s rokem 2025). Za vracející se soutěžící se považujeme ty, kteří mají WCA ID s rokem 2024 a méně. Všichni soutěžící musí i nadále dodržet všechny registrační požadavky, aby jejich registrace byla považována za kompletní. Registrace budou přijímány na základě následujících kritérií: * 50 % míst je vyhrazeno pro nové soutěžící. * Na zbylých 50 % míst budou přijati vracející se soutěžící podle pořadí přihlášení. * Po obsazení vyhrazené kapacity pro nováčky budou na zbývající místa přijímáni jak vracející se soutěžící, tak nováčci, podle pořadí přihlášení. * Nebude-li vyhrazená kapacita pro nováčky naplněna 2 týdny před začátkem soutěže, budou na tato místa přijímáni i vracející se soutěžící, dle pořadí registrace. #### **Pódium pro nováčky** S potěšením oznamujeme, že v kategorii 3x3x3 budeme vyhlašovat pódium pro nové soutěžící. ### ENGLISH This competition is participating in the official WCA Newcomer Month 2025. The registration process will reserve 50 % of spots for new competitors. New competitors are considered to have no WCA ID or a WCA ID with 2025. Returning competitors are considered to have a WCA ID that is from 2024 or earlier. All competitors must still follow all registration requirements for their registration to be considered complete. Registrations will be accepted based on the following: * 50 % of spots, as defined by the competitor limit, are reserved for new competitors. * Initially, 50 % of spots, as defined by the competitor limit, are available for returning competitors on a first come, first serve basis. * If greater than 50 % of new competitors register before 50 % of spots are filled by returning competitors, any additional new competitors will be accepted on a first come, first serve basis alongside returning competitors. * If the spots reserved for new competitors are not filled by new competitors before registration closes two weeks prior to the competition, remaining spots, up to the competitor limit, will be accepted from registered returning competitors. #### **Newcomer podium** We are excited to announce that special podium awards will be presented to newcomers in the 3x3x3 event.

The registration process will reserve 25 spots for new competitors. New competitors are considered to have no WCA ID or a WCA ID with 2025. Returning competitors are considered to have a WCA ID that is from 2024 or earlier. All competitors must still follow all registration requirements for their registration to be considered complete. ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6NTYwOTksInB1ciI6ImJsb2JfaWQifX0=--3eeb6c68eb32610efb332ea967640f7c06efad27/newcomer%202025.png) Registrations will be accepted based on the following: * 25 spots are reserved for new competitors. * Initially, 50 spots are available for returning competitors on a first come, first serve basis. * If greater than 25 new competitors register before 50 spots are filled by returning competitors, any additional new competitors will be accepted on a first come, first serve basis alongside returning competitors. * If the spots reserved for new competitors are not filled by new competitors before registration closes two weeks prior to the competition, remaining spots, up to the competitor limit, will be accepted from registered returning competitors.

items.information: ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6Mzc1OTIsInB1ciI6ImJsb2JfaWQifX0=--372977bde86c38926f2f6b5447e891ec8027a3f4/LIGA%20SLP%20AMARILLO.png) # **ESPAÑOL** Te invitamos a una serie de mini competencias que se llevarán a cabo en San Luis Potosí, totalmente gratuitas. Estas competencias están diseñadas para ofrecer a los participantes una experiencia divertida y relajada, ideal tanto para principiantes como para aquellos que quieran mejorar sus habilidades. ¡No pierdas la oportunidad de unirte y disfrutar de esta emocionante serie de eventos!. These competitions are designed to offer participants a fun and relaxed experience, ideal for beginners as well as those who want to improve their skills. Don’t miss the chance to join and enjoy this exciting series of events! This competition is recognized as an official competition of the World Cube Association. Therefore, all competitors must be familiar with and understand the [WCA regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/) prior to competition.

items.name: Linz Nikolaus Day 2025

venue.name: [Vokshaus Ebelsberg](https://www.linz.at/kultur/raum_37155.php)
venue.details: Follow the signs to enter the venue.

items.information: ***English version is below*** **Deutsch:** Wir freuen uns sehr euch Linz Nikolaus Day 2025 als ein offizielles WCA Turnier ankündigen zu können. Die Speedcubing Competition wird organisiert von Felizian Baumgartner, Julian Ostadal, Simon Praschl, Oskar Schöpl und Lukas Schwarz und delegiert von Florian Truckenthanner und Pranjal Khan. Das Turnier findet im Volkshaus Ebelsberg statt. Die Resultate dieser Competition werden zu den offiziellen WCA World Rankings hinzugefügt. Jeder ist bei diesem Turnier gerne willkommen, unabhängig von der Erfahrung, Alter oder sonstigen Fähigkeiten. Manche Events haben ein spezifisches Zeitlimit, damit wir sicherstellen können den ganzen Tag über im Zeitplan zu bleiben. Es dürfen Puzzles jeder Marke verwendet werden solange sie den WCA Richtlinien entsprechen. Es sind alle Herzlich willkommen! Jeder Teilnehmer darf einen Gast mitbringen. Wir freuen uns besonders auf neue Speedcuber aus Österreich! **English:** We are happy to announce the Linz Nikolaus Day 2025 as an official WCA Competition. The speedcubing competition is organised by Felizian Baumgartner, Julian Ostadal, Simon Praschl, Lukas Schwarz and Sebastian Feichtinger and delegated by Florian Truckenthanner and Pranjal Khan. Results of the competition will be added to the official WCA World Rankings. The competition is open to all competitors regardless of experience and skill, but certain event-based time limits will be in place to make sure we can stay on schedule and get through the day on time. No prior experience in WCA competitions is necessary, but competitors must be familiar with the WCA Regulations. Any puzzle brand may be used during the competition, as long as it complies with the WCA regulations. Every Competitor can bring one guest.

items.information: We're excited to welcome competitors back to Longmont for another day of speedcubing! Please make sure to read all tabs before registering. These tabs include important information regarding your responsibilities as a competitor and are very important! This competition has a 110 competitor limit. Please try to limit your guests that you bring to the competition! Competitions fill quickly, so it is recommended you register as soon as possible to save a spot. Be sure to familiarize yourself with the WCA regulations. If this is your first competition, please be present for the competitor tutorial at 7:45 AM. If you are unable to make the competition, please withdraw your registration as soon as possible by emailing the organizing team, to ensure competitors on the waitlist can compete. You will receive a 50 percent refund if you drop before the withdrawal deadline of (12:00 PM UTC 04-14-2025) This competition is financially supported by Colorado Cubers!

Después del gran éxito de Los Ángeles Comeback 2025, esta nueva edición busca seguir impulsando el desarrollo del cubo Rubik en el sur de Chile, reuniendo a competidores nuevos y experimentados en una jornada llena de desafíos, compañerismo y diversión. Don't miss it!!

items.information: ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBdlo2IiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--0981036a30347f039f2f8369d2f3c11a6625373f/LOGO_TORNEO_LOS_FUERTES.jpg) ##### Español **¡Bienvenidos a Los Fuertes Puebla 2024!** Puebla, la ciudad donde la grandeza se encuentra entre volcanes, se está preparando para recibirte en un próximo torneo y poner a prueba tus habilidades. ¿Qué tan fuerte podrás llegar? ¡Esto es un reto contra ti mismo! *¿Sabías que...?* El triángulo se considera la figura geométrica más fuerte. Cuando piensas en los volcanes, ¿qué categoría viene a tu mente? Así es como Pyraminx representa diferentes aspectos de este torneo. Estamos seguros que no esperabas tremendas referencias con el nombre, el lugar y nuestra categoría principal. Y aún hay más, ¡échale un vistazo a los detalles y verás la fusión! Esta competencia es posible gracias al apoyo del Presidente de **"Red Jóvenes X México Puebla"**, **Claudio Bañuelos**. Los Fuertes Puebla 2024 es una competencia oficial de la WCA por lo que todos los competidores deben estar familiarizados con el [Reglamento](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/spanish-american/). ##### English **¡Welcome to Los Fuertes Puebla 2024!** Puebla, the city where greatness lies among volcanoes, is gearing up to welcome you to an upcoming competition and test your skills. How strong will you be able to become? This is a challenge against yourself! *Did you know...?* That triangle is considered the strongest geometric shape. When thinking about volcanoes, which is the category that comes to your mind? This is how Pyraminx represents different aspects of this competition. We're sure you weren't expecting such remarkable references between the name, location and our main event. And there's still more, take a look at the details and you'll see the fusion! This competition is possible thanks to the support of the President of **"Red Jóvenes X México Puebla"**, **Claudio Bañuelos**. Los Fuertes Puebla 2024 is a WCA official competition, hence all participants should be familiar with the [Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations).

items.name: Loutraki Open 2023
items.information: ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBaVpJIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--4b69d3e8ec74c2e903cc944222c628b961b4e6ae/357003767_748136693777038_1928584195019389868_n.jpg) To Loutraki Open 2023 είναι ο 4ος διαγωνισμός WCA στην Ελλάδα για το 2023. Ο διαγωνισμός γίνεται στις 16 και 17 Σεπτεμβρίου 2023 στην Κορινθία που είναι η γενέτειρα του Παναγιώτη Βερδέ, ιδρυτή και εφευρέτη των Ελληνικών κύβων [V-CUBE](https://www.v-cubes.com/) , που έχουν φτάσει σε 116 χώρες. Οι Ελληνικοί κύβοι [V-CUBE](https://www.v-cubes.com) ήταν αυτοί που από το 2008 επέκτειναν την σειρά των κύβων από το 5χ5. Το Loutraki Open 2023 τελεί υπό την αιγίδα του WCA και διοργανώνεται από το ηλεκτρονικό κατάστημα [GamesUniverse.gr](https://gamesuniverse.gr/el/) , την [V-CUBE](https://www.v-cubes.com/) και την [V-Games](https://v-games.eu/) , όπου ανήκουν στην εταιρεία [Καινοτομίες Βερδέ ΑΕΒΕ](https://gamesuniverse.gr/el/content/8-poioi-eimaste). Πάρτε τους κύβους σας, ετοιμαστείτε, διαβάστε τους κανόνες και ελάτε στο [Sport Camp](https://www.sportcamp.gr/el) στο Λουτράκι για μια μοναδική εμπειρία και γιορτή του cubing! Παρακαλoύμε διαβάστε αναλυτικά τόσο την παρούσα σελίδα όσο και τις επόμενες σελίδες Σημείωση: Για να θεωρείται ολοκληρωμένη μία εγγραφή πρέπει να ολοκληρωθεί το registration στο σελίδα του διαγωνισμού στην WCA KAI να γίνει και η πληρωμή του αντιτίμου συμμετοχής όπως περιγράφεται στις καρτέλες δίπλα. [Εγγραφή στη WCA, σε επίσημο διαγωνισμό και πολλά ακόμα. Οδηγός για πρωτάρηδες.](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=RS768gK0Vrg&feature=youtu.be) Σημείωση Αποδοχής κινηματογράφησης ή φωτογράφισης. Οι διαγωνιζόμενοι και οι συμμετέχοντες με την συμμετοχή τους στο Loutraki Open 2023 αυτόματα συμφωνούν με την πιθανή χρήση των εικόνων τους από τους διοργανωτές σε προωθητικές ενέργειες, κοινωνικά δίκτυα και άλλες ψηφιακές ενέργειες. Οι online εγγραφές ανοίγουν στις 31.07.2023 και κλείνουν στις 11.09.2023. Loutraki Open is the 4th WCA Competition in Greece during 2023. The competition is taking place on the 16th and 17th September 2023 at Korinthia prefecture which is the place of birth of Panagiotis Verdes, who is the founder and inventor of the Greek Cubes [V-CUBE](https://www.v-cubes.com/) that have reached 116 countries. The Greek Cubes [V-CUBE](https://www.v-cubes.com) were the ones that since 2008 they have extended the cube line with cubes of more than 5 layers. Loutraki Open 2023 is an official WCA competition and is co-organized from the e-shop [GamesUniverse.gr](https://gamesuniverse.gr/el/) , [V-CUBE](https://www.v-cubes.com/) and [V-Games](https://v-games.eu/) , that they all belong to [Verdes innovations S.A](https://gamesuniverse.gr/el/content/8-poioi-eimaste) . Grab your cubes, get ready, read the rules and come to [Sport Camp](https://www.sportcamp.gr/el) at Loutraki for an unforgettable experience and celebration of cubing! Please read the following and the rest of the tabs very carefully. Note: For a registration to be considered valid, the competitor should both register though the WCA site AND pay the registration fee as described in the next tabs. Please read the following tabs in detail to find all the necessary information. Notice of Acceptance for Filming or Photography Competitors and other Attendees of Loutraki Open consent to their images being used by the organizers and its partners in marketing and promotional actions and materials, social media and other digital platforms. Online registration open 31.07.2023 and close 11.09.2023.

items.name: Luzern Sunset Solves 2026
items.information: ![Luzern Sunset Solves 2026](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MTg3MjAzLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--3f1469f95a09ed6979eb78aee757aa8b02c975e8/logo_without_bg.png) [*DE*] ###Dieser Wettkampf wird für die Events 2x2x2, 3x3x3 One-Handed, Pyraminx und 3x3x3 Blindfolded in zwei Gruppen durchgeführt. Du wirst in einer Gruppe antreten und in der anderen Gruppe entweder als Runner, Judge oder Scrambler mithelfen. Wenn du in einem dieser Events teilnimmst, MUSST du während der gesamten Dauer beider Gruppen anwesend sein (d.h. von 19:30 bis 21:10 Uhr), sonst darfst du nicht teilnehmen. Möchtest Du nur beim 3x3x3 (Tab "3x3x3 Dual Round" beachten) mitmachen, kannst Du natürlich vorher schon gehen. ###Bitte lies vor deiner Anmeldung unbedingt den Reiter „Special Format“. --- [*EN*] ###This competition will be run in two groups for the events 2x2x2, 3x3x3 One-Handed, Pyraminx and 3x3x3 Blindfolded. You will compete in one group and help out in the other group as a runner, judge, or scrambler. If you participate in one of these events, you MUST be present for the entire duration of both groups (i.e. from 19:30 to 21:10), otherwise you cannot participate. items.information: **STEPS OF REGISTRATION** Click On [Register](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/M5OpenABengaluru2025/register) Scroll Down Select the Events and register for the competition Make the Payment Click the [Payment Tab](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/M5OpenABengaluru2025#65504-payment) or the Payment process after you are done with the registration below. The Participant should compulsorily register on WCA and should make the payment before November 5th 2025.. Please check your respective mail ID's through which you will receive all the communications from Speed Cubing Bangalore. **All the Newcomers** are requested to get their **valid ID proofs** with Date of Birth Mentioned on it. For the Returning Participants: Please claim your WCA ID if you have not claimed it yet. Link is provided below. [How To Claim your WCA ID](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=3widl70-Uus) **First time participants** Step 1 - Sign-up on WCA. You must mention your full name without any abbrevations while creating your WCA profile. Step 2 - Register for the competition Step 3 - [Pay here](https://www.cubelelo.com/products/m5-open-a-bengaluru-2025-competition) **Returning participants** Step 1 - Sign-in using your email that you used for your previous competitions Step 2 - Register for the competition. Step 3 -[Pay here](https://www.cubelelo.com/products/m5-open-a-bengaluru-2025-competition) Registration for the event will only be accepted if a person has preregistered on the WCA page AND made the payment. **Fees Structure:** Flat fee of ₹1000 irrespective of number of events Please do the payment of each participant separately. Note: 1) It is mandatory to pay the registration fees and also register on WCA to complete the full registration process. 2) It may take a day or 2 for your name to reflect on competitors list on WCA. **Important Note** **We have enabled On-the-spot registrations for this competition. If you could not register in WCA or make the payment, directly report at the venue at the check-in time and you will be allowed to participate as long as the overall limit of 75 competitors is not reached.**

Para mais informações, acesse a aba de [Inscrição](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/IICapixabaChallenge2025/register); - Recomendamos chegar ao local da competição pelo menos 30 minutos antes do início da modalidade em que você irá participar; - Certifique-se de que o cubo que você usará na competição esteja em boas condições, pois cubos danificados podem ser recusados; - Estamos aqui para ajudar! Se você tiver alguma dúvida, fique à vontade para perguntar; - Se este for o seu primeiro campeonato, assista a [este vídeo](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=UHqunxu3rOU); - Antes da competição, leia as [Regulamentações da WCA](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/portuguese-brazilian) para estar familiarizado com as regras; - Este campeonato destina-se a iniciantes. Consideramos iniciante aquele que nunca competiu antes ou que participou em, no máximo, duas competições. - Divirta-se e aproveite ao máximo! ​ ------------------------------------- ​ 🇺🇸 We are excited to welcome you and want to share some essential tips for competitors and companions: ​ - Your registration will be confirmed on the WCA website as soon as the payment is confirmed and the receipt is sent. For more information, visit the [Registration](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/IICapixabaChallenge/register) tab; - We recommend arriving at the competition venue at least 30 minutes before the start of the event you will participate in; - Make sure that the cube you will use in the competition is in good condition, as damaged cubes may not be accepted; - We are here to assist you! If you have any questions, feel free to ask; - If this is your first competition, watch [this video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=UHqunxu3rOU); - Before the competition, read the [WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations) to become familiar with the rules; - This championship is intended for beginners. We consider a beginner to be someone who has never competed before or who has participated in a maximum of two competitions. - Have fun and make the most of the experience! ​ ------------------------------------- #### Organização/Organization: ​ ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBc1JMIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--21d308c05a84a509a0a5091b9aae85d06e9b68c7/speedcubes-logo-0.25x.png)

items.name: MSU Quiet Qualifier 2022
items.information: # Competitors may bring at most one guest. This will be checked at the entrance of the competition. No external spectators are allowed, only those coming with a confirmed competitor will be allowed in the venue. # All attendees (competitors + guests) must show valid proof of at least one of the following two requirements to be allowed in the venue: ##### 1) They are fully vaccinated against COVID-19. To clarify, an individual is only considered fully vaccinated if they have received their second dose of a two-dose vaccine (Pfizer or Moderna) or their only dose of a single-dose vaccine (J&J) more than two weeks before the competition. Any dose received after Saturday, April 30th is insufficient for entrance to the competition. ##### **OR** ##### 2) They tested negative for COVID-19 within 96 hours (4 days) of the competition. The date when the test is conducted is what matters, not the date when the results are received. Any test conducted earlier than Tuesday, May 10th is insufficient for entrance to the competition. ####

items.information: ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6NTYyNjAsInB1ciI6ImJsb2JfaWQifX0=--664f7af1cb593a99c2c06ca90444fbfb49eff7db/LOGO%20CAMPEONATO.jpg)[](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6NTYyNTgsInB1ciI6ImJsb2JfaWQifX0=--61d1447a942fc176de0673dc670e37b5a873f2ec/LOGO%20CAMPEONATO.jpg) # Português A inscrição é aberta a qualquer pessoa, de qualquer nacionalidade. Visando o bom andamento da competição, **ao se inscrever em uma categoria, você se compromete também a ajudar como juiz ou embaralhador** nessa categoria (conforme previsto nas regras da WCA). Dessa forma, a competição se torna autossustentável, e as atividades são divididas entre todos os participantes, não ficando pesado para apenas alguns. Foram previstos pelo menos dois grupos em cada modalidade. Em um dos grupos, você compete; no outro, deverá ajudar a embaralhar ou sendo juiz. **ATENÇÃO:** Competidores **menores de 16 anos devem estar acompanhadas por um responsável**. Ressaltamos que a competição ocorrerá em um espaço público, e a organização não se responsabiliza pela supervisão das crianças. **COMPETIDORES NOVATOS** devem asssitir [a este vídeo](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=UHqunxu3rOU&pp=ygUPYWJyYWNtIHR1dG9yaWFs) para aprender como competir em uma competição oficial de Cubo Mágico. **Não haverá tutorial para competidores novatos no dia da competição** As inscrições custam R$ 35,00 (trinta e cinco reais) e se encerram no dia 22 de janeiro de 2025 às 23h59min (horário local). A sua inscrição só será aceita após o cumprimento de todas as etapas de inscrição (pagamento e envio do comprovante por e-mail, com todas as informações solicitadas). O pagamento da inscrição não dá direito a acompanhantes. Convidados e espectadores, inclusive os responsáveis por menores de 16 anos, devem pagar uma taxa de R$ 10,00 (dez reais) para poderem ingressar no evento, preferencialmente antecipadamente. O espaço comporta apenas 35 acompanhantes no total, de modo que reservamos 1 acompanhante por competidor. Caso você queira levar mais de 1 acompanhante, sugerimos garantir vaga do 1o acompanhante e colocar os demais na lista de espera. Ao término das inscrições, entraremos em contato informando caso sobrem vagas de acompanhantes, para que você exerça a opção de levar mais. Inscrições no local serão aceitas no valor de R$ 45,00 (quarenta e cinco reais), caso haja vagas. Acompanhantes e espectadores poderão comprar seu ingresso no dia pelo valor de R$ 20,00 (vinte reais), caso haja vagas. **Modalidade não-oficial:** Este campeonato contará com uma modalidade extra e inovadora: Skewb OH (com uma mão) # English Registration is open to any person, from any country. To ensure the smooth running of the competition, **by registering for an event, you also undertake to help as a judge or scrambler** in that event (as provided by the WCA rules). In this way, the competition becomes self-sustaining, and the activities are divided among all participants, not becoming overwhelming for just a few. Each event will have at least two groups for each event. In one of the groups, you compete; in the other you should help to scramble or as a judge. **ATTENTION:** Competitors **under 16 must be accompanied by a guardian**. Please note that the competition will take place in a public space, and the organization is not responsible for supervising children. **FIRST TIME COMPETITORS** must watch [this video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=UHqunxu3rOU&pp=ygUPYWJyYWNtIHR1dG9yaWFs) In order to learn how to compete in an official Rubik's Cube competition. **No tutorial for newcomers will occur at the competition** Registration costs R$35.00 (thirty five Brazilian reais) and close on January 22, 2025 at 23:59 (local time). Your registration will only be accepted once all the registration steps have been completed (payment and sending of proof) by e-mail, with all the information required). Payment of registration fee does not guarantee the competitor a companion. Guests and spectators, including the guardians of people under 16, must pay a fee of R$10.00 to enter the event, preferably in advance. The space can only hold 35 companions in total, so we reserve 1 companion per competitor. If you would like to bring more than 1 companion, we suggest that you secure a place for the 1st companion and put the others on the waiting list. At the end of registration, we'll contact you to let you know if there are any places left, so that you can choose to bring more. On-site registrations will be accepted for R$45.00 (fourty five Brazilian reais), if there are still places. Guests and spectators can buy their tickets on the day for R$20.00 (twenty Brazilian reais), if there are still places. **Unofficial Event:** This competition will count with an extra and innovative event: Skewb OH (one-handed)

Now, it becomes the official place for this competition, which is the second part of the **Ruta Regia**. We invite you to be part of this tournament that will be held in the center of the city, which is open to anyone. items.information: "Madryn al Cubo 2022" contará con **7 categorias** (3x3 - 4x4 - 5x5 - 2x2 - Pyraminx - One Hand - Megaminx) y **11 rondas** en total. El objetivo es que los competidores de la region puedan actualizar sus tiempos y seguir mejorando. Contamos con la experiencia de haber organizado el [Patagonia Open 2019](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/PatagoniaOpen2019) y el [Argentina ReOpen 2021](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/ArgentinaReOpen2021) con gran éxito. El cupo maximo de competidores será de 25, con **1 acompañante como maximo** (padre, madre, hermano, tutor, amigo, etc) pudiendose anotar a todas las categorias que deseen pagando 1 sola inscripcion. **Se ruega puntualidad**. items.information: **Important Information for Participants:** **Location:** The competition will take place at the conference hall. **Arrival Time:** Please ensure that you arrive at the venue at least 30 minutes before your event starts. Latecomers will not be permitted to participate. **Volunteering:** All participants are kindly requested to volunteer during the competition. **First-Time Participants:** If this is your first time participating in a WCA competition or if you're unfamiliar with the competition rules, we strongly recommend reviewing the WCA regulations beforehand. **ID Requirement:** First-time participants are required to bring an original, printed, or digital copy of their official ID card. Please ensure you have this with you.. **Cube Requirement:** Participants must bring their own cubes. Participants are responsible for the safety of the puzzles. If you have difficulty bringing puzzles, please contact us in advance so that we can make arrangements for you. **International Participants:** If you are a citizen from outside India, please submit a copy of your Government-issued ID. We look forward to seeing you at the competition! If you have any questions or concerns, please don't hesitate to reach out to us. **On The Spot Registration** * On The Spot (OTS) Registration has been enabled for this competition if 50 competitors do not complete online registration. * All OTS Registrants have to come on time and follow the schedule * OTS Registrations are only available on day 2 of the competition * OTS Registration is only available from 8:00 AM to 8:30 AM * OTS Registration is only available for 3x3, 2x2 and 3x3 OH

items.information: ## Welcome to the Malaysia Newcomer 2025! [![Newcomer logo](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6NjA4NzMsInB1ciI6ImJsb2JfaWQifX0=--17cadd2ced923d2d26251d09fce733b54618627e/%EC%8A%A4%ED%81%AC%EB%A6%B0%EC%83%B7%202024-12-25%2000.10.29.png)](https://linktr.ee/newcomermonth) [![Malaysia Cube Sports Association(MYCSA)](https://i.imgur.com/ZUv6wZJm.png)](https://www.mycubeassociation.org/competition/info/MalaysiaNewComer2025) This competition is participating in the official WCA Newcomer Month 2025. The registration process will reserve 50% of spots for new competitors. New competitors are considered to have no WCA ID or a WCA ID with 2025. Returning competitors are considered to have a WCA ID that is from 2024 or earlier. All competitors must still follow all registration requirements for their registration to be considered complete. Registrations will be accepted based on the following: - 50% of spots, as defined by the competitor limit, are reserved for new competitors. Initially, 50% of spots, as defined by the competitor limit, are available for returning competitors on a first come, first serve basis. - If greater than 50% of new competitors register before 50% of spots are filled by returning competitors, any additional new competitors will be accepted on a first come, first serve basis alongside returning competitors. - If the spots reserved for new competitors are not filled by new competitors before registration closes two weeks prior to the competition, remaining spots, up to the competitor limit, will be accepted from registered returning competitors. **Kindly read through all tabs on this page as they contain very useful information.** All competitors are advised to review the information provided in the ["**Updates & Announcements**"](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/MalaysiaNewComer2025#54278-updates-announcements). items.information: 8 años después de nuestra última competición, os presentanos el Rubik Mallorca Open 2022. Un torneo de speedcubing en esta maravillosa isla del mediterraneo donde podrás disfrutar de 2 días de competicion con rondas de casi todas las categorías oficiales, que se realizarán en el mismo hotel en que podrás hospedarte. En la edición de 2014 contamos con hasta 6 nacionalidades diferentes, y ahora ha llegado el momento de superarlo. ¡Os estaremos esperando! 8 years after our last competition, we are glad to present you the Rubik Mallorca Open 2022. A speedcubing tournament on this wonderful Mediterranean island where you'll be able to enjoy 2 days of competition with rounds of almost all official categories, which will take place in the same venue you'll stay. In the 2014 edition we had up to 6 different nationalities, and we plan to overcome it this year. So don't be afraid to join us. We'll be waiting for you!

items.name: Maltby Mega Special 2023
items.information: - This competition takes place on a Sunday. Please plan accordingly. - Due to venue capacity, we ask that competitors bring a **maximum of one guest each**. Spectators are also only permitted as companions of competitors. - While the competition takes place in the main floor, you are welcome to sit in the upper area. The kitchen, however, is off limits. - Please take the time to read the Parking tab if you decide to register. There is limited parking space in front of the venue, but there is space nearby so you should know how to navigate your way to the competition. - Keep in mind that Multi-Blind takes place at the beginning of the competition, so if you decide to arrive during the event, please be mindful to be quiet until all competitors have finished. This competition is recognized as an official World Cube Association competition. Therefore, all competitors must be familiar with the [WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/). If you are new to competing, please refer to the [Competitor Responsibilities](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/MaltbyMegaEventsSpecial2023#29297-please-read-competitor-responsibilities) tab. items.information: REGISTRO A participação nessa competição requer do competidor o conhecimento dos seguintes requisitos: 1. Tomar todos os cuidados referente ao COVID-19 e seguir o que será indicado pelo delegado e organizador da competição; 2. Conhecer as regras da WCA, pois é uma competição oficial; 3. Escolher os eventos a serem registrados com cuidado após revisar as guias Eventos e Cronograma. Preste atenção aos formatos das rodadas e seus cortes/limites; 4. Se inscrever através do site da WCA, realizar o pagamento de forma antecipada e mandar o comprovante para o organizador através do e-mail (lojagcubos@gmail.com) indicando o nome completo do participante; 5. Aguardar até que o registro eletrônico seja aceito. Caso não participe mesmo com o pagamento, não haverá devolução do dinheiro. Não serão aceitas inscrições no dia da competição; 6. Em virtude do COVID-19, o local só irá comportar um número máximo de 30 competidores e 30 convidados; 7. Outras informações adicionais verifique no site da WCA ou entre em contato com o organizador através do e-mail (lojagcubos@gmail.com), bem como o delegado por meio do e-mail (gsantos@worldcubeassociation.org). REGISTRATION The participation in this competition requires the comprehension and acceptance of the following requirements: 1. Take all precautions regarding COVID-19 and follow what will be indicated by the delegate and the organizer; 2. Being familiar with the WCA rules, since this is an official competition; 3. Carefully choosing the events. Keep the rounds format, cutoffs and limits in mind. 4. Register through the WCA website, pay in advance and send proof to the organizer via email (lojagcubos@gmail.com) indicating the participant's full name; 5. Wait for your registration to be approved online. In the case of not participating and having already paid the registration, no money will be returned. Registrations will not be accepted on the day of the competition; 6. Due to COVID-19, the venue will only hold a maximum of 30 competitors and 30 guests 7. For additional information, check the WCA website or contact the organizer via email, (lojagcubos@gmail.com), or the delegate via email (gsantos@worldcubeassociation.org).

items.information: **Português** Será um prazer recebê-los e temos algumas dicas para vocês, competidores e acompanhantes: - Chegue ao local da competição 30 minutos antes de modalidade que participará; - O cubo que você irá competir deve estar em bom estado, portanto, cuide bem dele; - Se tiver alguma dúvida, não hesite em perguntar. A nossa competição é formada por alguns competidores experientes, mas sempre teremos espaço para novos cubistas. - Procure se divertir bastante! **English** It will be a pleasure to receive you and we have some tips for you, competitors and companions: - Arrive at the competition site 30 minutes before the modality that will participate; - The cube you will be competing in must be in good condition, so take good care of it; - At the time of the awards, at the end of Sunday, we will draw some cubes for the competitors. Only win who is present and no one can win twice; - If you have any questions, do not hesitate to ask. Our competition is made up of some experienced competitors, but we will always have room for new cubists. - Try to have a lot of fun!

items.information: **🇧🇷 Português:** A competição é aberta a participantes de todas as idades. No dia do campeonato, as inscrições serão aceitas apenas para a categoria 3x3x3. A inscrição deve ser feita exclusivamente pelo site, com o pagamento antecipado da taxa via Stripe, diretamente na plataforma da WCA. A confirmação da inscrição no site da WCA ocorrerá somente após a validação do pagamento. Para mais detalhes, acesse a aba Inscrever. On the day of the championship, registrations will only be accepted for the 3x3x3 category. Registration must be completed exclusively through the website, with the registration fee paid in advance via Stripe, directly on the WCA platform. Registration on the WCA website will only be confirmed after payment validation. For more details, visit the Register tab. If you have any difficulties registering, watch this [video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=UHqunxu3rOU) for instructions. Before the competition, please read the [WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/) carefully. By registering, you authorize AACM, WCA, and their partners to use your image in photos and videos taken during the event, free of charge, including for commercial purposes.
